notes.title: Russian and Traditional Chinese Available, Switch/PS/Xbox Version Coming 2/18!
notes.notes:
I'm happy to announce that the Russian and Traditional Chinese versions are now available!
Further, Anodyne 2 will be launching on Switch,  PS4/5, Xbox One/Series on February 18th!

Thanks for your support and be sure to join our newsletter to keep up with the latest news on our next game, codenamed "S"!
